sections.heading: 1. Natural (Exhaustible) Resources
points: **Inexhaustible** resources — unlimited, not exhausted by human use (sunlight, air).
**Exhaustible** resources — limited, can be used up (fossil fuels, minerals, forests, wildlife).
**Coal, petroleum and natural gas** are **fossil fuels** — formed from the **dead remains of ancient plants/animals** over millions of years; **non-renewable**.

sections.heading: 2. Coal
points: Formed from dead **vegetation** buried and compressed over ages (process = **carbonisation**).

sub: **Coke** — almost pure carbon; used in making steel and extracting metals.
**Coal tar** — a black liquid; source of dyes, drugs, explosives, paints, perfumes.

sections.heading: 3. Petroleum and Natural Gas
points: **Petroleum ('rock oil')** — formed from remains of tiny **sea organisms**; called **'black gold'**.
Extracted by **drilling wells**; separated by **refining** in a **refinery** (fractional distillation).
**Natural gas** — a clean fuel; stored as **CNG (Compressed Natural Gas)**; also used to make fertilisers; **PCRA** promotes conservation.

sections.heading: 4. Conservation
points: Fossil fuels are **limited and cause pollution** → must be **conserved**.
Tips (PCRA): drive at steady speed, switch off engines at signals, maintain vehicles, use public transport.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Fossil fuels = coal, petroleum, natural gas (non-renewable, from ancient remains).
Coal products: coke (steel), coal tar (dyes/drugs), coal gas (fuel); carbonisation forms coal.
Petroleum = 'black gold'; refined by fractional distillation into LPG, petrol, diesel, kerosene, bitumen.
Natural gas stored as CNG (clean fuel); PCRA promotes conservation.
Petroleum forms from tiny sea organisms; coal from vegetation.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Coke** (from coal) is almost pure **carbon**, used in steel-making.
Petroleum is separated by **fractional distillation (refining)**, not filtration.
